before_start: {"blocks":[{"key":"2lek4","text":"Environment and Room Setup","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[{"style":"bold","offset":0,"length":26},{"style":"italic","offset":0,"length":26}],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"64pes","text":"Conduct video acquisition in a room with sufficient, evenly distributed lighting to ensure clear visualization of the EEG cap, electrodes, and fiducial landmarks.","type":"unordered-list-item","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"rem1","text":"Remove or cover reflective surfaces, including mirrors, glass panels, and metallic objects, as reflections can introduce errors during image alignment and 3D reconstruction.","type":"unordered-list-item","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"8bnt9","text":"Provide adequate space around the participant (approximately 1 to 2 meters of clearance) to allow the camera operator to move freely and capture all viewing angles.","type":"unordered-list-item","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"egk7i","text":"Seat the participant in a stable, non-swivel chair with back support to help maintain a consistent posture throughout recording.","type":"unordered-list-item","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}

description: {"blocks":[{"key":"5gjde","text":"This protocol describes an offline video-based photogrammetry workflow to generate 3D head models for EEG electrode localization from video recorded on a smartphone, tablet, digital camera, or other handheld device. The frames extracted from the video are reconstructed locally using RealityCapture, providing a low-cost, privacy-preserving alternative to cloud-based photogrammetry applications that require uploading identifiable participant data to external servers. Following this protocol produces a textured 3D head model suitable for electrode digitization in software such as Brainstorm, EEGLAB, FieldTrip, or MeshLab. The resulting electrode coordinates can then be scaled to anatomical units for use in EEG source localization and related neuroimaging analyses.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}

Users are responsible for obtaining all required ethics approvals and informed consent, and for handling identifiable participant data in accordance with applicable institutional policies and local regulations.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}
ethics_statement: {"blocks":[{"key":"18k2f","text":"This protocol involves video recordings of human participants and should only be performed with prior approval from the appropriate institutional ethics committee, in accordance with local regulations. Written informed consent should be obtained from all participants before data collection, including consent for video recording and the generation of 3D head models for EEG electrode localization. Researchers should implement appropriate measures to protect participant privacy and securely store identifiable data in accordance with institutional policies and applicable data protection regulations.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}

guidelines: {"blocks":[{"key":"b7bbo","text":"Purpose: This protocol provides step-by-step instructions for acquiring video recordings and generating 3D head models for EEG electrode localization using an accessible, low-cost, offline photogrammetry workflow.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[{"style":"bold","offset":0,"length":8},{"style":"italic","offset":0,"length":9}],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"c3jjr","text":"","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"fc4hp","text":"Privacy Considerations: Use a handheld video recording device, such as a digital camera, smartphone, or tablet. {"blocks":[{"key":"1thdr","text":"Align Images","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[{"style":"bold","offset":0,"length":12}],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"6j9f9","text":"Register all input images to estimate their camera positions and generate a sparse 3D point cloud.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[{"style":"italic","offset":0,"length":98}],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}

{"blocks":[{"key":"2vr7k","text":"Generate Texture","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[{"style":"bold","offset":0,"length":16}],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"5qjgk","text":"Generate the model texture and apply color to the 3D model.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[{"style":"italic","offset":0,"length":59}],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}

{"blocks":[{"key":"4gmp7","text":"Record Video of Participant Wearing EEG Cap","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[{"style":"bold","offset":0,"length":43}],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}

{"blocks":[{"key":"670ae","text":"After creating the 3D model, digitize the electrode locations using one of the following supported software packages:","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"begrf","text":"FieldTrip (Homölle \u0026 Oostenveld, 2019)","type":"unordered-list-item","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"enno8","text":"EEGLAB (get_chanlocs plugin; Lee \u0026 Makeig, 2024)","type":"unordered-list-item","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[{"style":"italic","offset":8,"length":12}],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"5m652","text":"Brainstorm (Chinara et al., 2024)","type":"unordered-list-item","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"4b8ef","text":"MeshLab (Diaz-Fong et al., 2024)","type":"unordered-list-item","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}

{"blocks":[{"key":"3u48c","text":"The mesh produced by RealityCapture is reconstructed at an arbitrary scale because photogrammetry estimates 3D geometry from the relative positions of features across overlapping 2D images but, without a known physical reference, cannot determine their absolute dimensions. To rescale electrode coordinates into true anatomical units (cm or mm), use the head circumference recorded in Step 1 as a ground truth measurement.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[{"style":"italic","offset":21,"length":15},{"style":"bold","offset":385,"length":7}],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}

{"blocks":[{"key":"s8ot","text":"Ensure Visibility of Electrodes and Fiducials","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[{"style":"bold","offset":0,"length":45}],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}

{"blocks":[{"key":"75lao","text":"Prepare Software","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[{"style":"bold","offset":0,"length":16}],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"7b304","text":"Launch the RealityCapture software (v1.5.1).","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[{"style":"italic","offset":0,"length":10},{"style":"italic","offset":11,"length":26},{"style":"italic","offset":42,"length":1}],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"asbvd","text":" ","type":"atomic","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[{"key":0,"offset":0,"length":1}],"data":{}},{"key":"5g1b3","text":"","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{"0":{"type":"software","mutability":"IMMUTABLE","data":{"id":4383,"guid":"59D34963CBE949C8A67CE4888DDAC384","name":"RealityCapture","version":"1.5.1","os_name":"Windows","os_version":"10 or 11","developer":"Epic Games","repository":"","link":"","is_public":true,"can_edit":false}}}}

{"blocks":[{"key":"f3vq0","text":"Set Reconstruction Region","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[{"style":"bold","offset":0,"length":25}],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"4f2bm","text":"Restrict the scene reconstruction to a specific volume.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[{"style":"italic","offset":0,"length":55}],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}

{"blocks":[{"key":"ftefk","text":"Generate Mesh","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[{"style":"bold","offset":0,"length":13}],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"8fsin","text":"Create a 3D model for the currently selected component.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[{"style":"italic","offset":0,"length":55}],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}

{"blocks":[{"key":"1pp7e","text":"Export Model","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[{"style":"bold","offset":0,"length":12}],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"87t9","text":"Export the model as a mesh and texture file.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[{"style":"italic","offset":0,"length":44}],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}

{"blocks":[{"key":"6b59s","text":"In the Mesh Model tab, under Export, select Dense Mesh Model to export the mesh.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[{"style":"bold","offset":7,"length":10},{"style":"bold","offset":29,"length":6},{"style":"bold","offset":44,"length":17}],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}

Example export settings for saving the reconstructed model as a Wavefront (.obj) mesh with a single texture file.\",\"type\":\"unstyled\",\"depth\":0,\"inlineStyleRanges\":[{\"style\":\"bold\",\"offset\":0,\"length\":11},{\"style\":\"italic\",\"offset\":0,\"length\":124}],\"entityRanges\":[],\"data\":{}}],\"entityMap\":{}}","mime":"image/png","originalFile":{},"original_name":"image.png","placeholder":"https://content.protocols.io/files/bgcdybbt6x.png","source":"https://content.protocols.io/files/bg73ybbt6x.jpg","type":1,"webp_source":"https://content.protocols.io/files/bg73xbbt6x.webp","width":580}},"1":{"type":"notes","mutability":"IMMUTABLE","data":{"blocks":[{"data":{},"depth":0,"entityRanges":[],"inlineStyleRanges":[{"length":4,"offset":45,"style":"bold"},{"length":4,"offset":63,"style":"bold"},{"length":4,"offset":90,"style":"bold"}],"key":"5vtkr","text":"A successful export produces three files: an .obj mesh file, a .png texture image, and an .mtl material file.","type":"unstyled"}],"collapsed":false,"entityMap":{}}}}}

{"blocks":[{"key":"bgqf4","text":"Using a handheld device (e.g., a digital camera, smartphone or tablet), record approximately one minute of video.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}

{"blocks":[{"key":"3clb","text":"While walking around the participant, ensure the video captures all angles of the EEG cap, including the sides, back, and top of the head.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[{"style":"italic","offset":64,"length":10},{"style":"italic","offset":122,"length":15}],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}

{"blocks":[{"key":"ajre9","text":"Keep the participant’s head and EEG cap centered in the video frame while including some background context to aid in the reconstruction process. Avoid cropping out the head or cap at any point during the recording.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}

{"blocks":[{"key":"50ugq","text":"Check video recording quality, and repeat if necessary.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"44jop","text":"","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"dlri4","text":" ","type":"atomic","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[{"key":0,"offset":0,"length":1}],"data":{}},{"key":"3h6u8","text":"","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{"0":{"type":"notes","mutability":"IMMUTABLE","data":{"blocks":[{"data":{},"depth":0,"entityRanges":[],"inlineStyleRanges":[],"key":"vpb5","text":"Ensure the recording environment remains unchanged during acquisition; moving objects, changing lighting conditions, or other environmental disturbances may negatively impact reconstruction quality.","type":"unstyled"}],"collapsed":false,"entityMap":{}}}}}

{"blocks":[{"key":"2mahu","text":"Measure and record the participant's head circumference using a flexible measuring tape. Position the tape so that it passes just above the eyebrows at the front of the head, above the ears on both sides, and around the most prominent part of the back of the head (inion). Ensure that the tape remains level and is snug against the scalp without compressing the skin. Record the head circumference in centimeters, to the nearest 0.1 cm when possible.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"4rlpj","text":"    ","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}

{"blocks":[{"key":"9jqt4","text":"Place the EEG cap on the participant's head, fitted per manufacturer's instructions.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"7e5lh","text":"","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"9p2m1","text":" ","type":"atomic","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[{"key":0,"offset":0,"length":1}],"data":{}},{"key":"ct251","text":"","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{"0":{"type":"notes","mutability":"IMMUTABLE","data":{"blocks":[{"data":{},"depth":0,"entityRanges":[],"inlineStyleRanges":[],"key":"dfjij","text":"For EEG caps with manually inserted electrodes, perform the video recording before electrode placement to prevent the electrode wires from obstructing the recording.","type":"unstyled"}],"collapsed":false,"entityMap":{}}}}}

{"blocks":[{"key":"mtbk","text":"Confirm that all electrodes and their labels are visible and unobstructed.     ","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}

{"blocks":[{"key":"aornl","text":"If necessary, gently move hair away from these areas and secure it underneath the EEG cap or with accessories like clips or hair ties.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}

{"blocks":[{"key":"dclk0","text":"Have the participant take a seat in a chair placed in the center of the room. ","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}

{"blocks":[{"key":"d7r3d","text":"Ensure fiducial landmarks (e.g., nasion, inion, preauricular points) are clearly visible and not obscured by hair or wires.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}

{"blocks":[{"key":"8jh0s","text":"In the Workflow tab, click on Video Sequence, and select the participant’s video recording.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[{"style":"bold","offset":7,"length":9},{"style":"bold","offset":30,"length":14}],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}
